description: Semantic category -> Theo Dark palette color. Used by apply_theo_palette.py to recolor SVGs and by icon_to_excalidraw.py for default fills. Source of truth: ../color-palette.md (dark mode).

primary.description: Brand purple. CTAs, highlights, headers, memory core.

secondary.description: Blue. Secondary actions, semantic recall, on-demand.

accent.description: Yellow. Attention, badges, key numbers, emphasis.

warning.description: Red (soft). Errors, blocked, invalidated. Use sparingly.

ai.description: Light purple. AI/LLM-specific elements, reflections, agent.

neutral.description: Default text color inside shapes. Use when no semantic applies.

muted.description: Secondary text, descriptions, body. Lower hierarchy.

structural.description: Borders, grids, structural lines. Background structure.

subtle.description: Arrow labels, inactive elements, dashed strokes.
